verbatim.message: Access to statsapi.mlb.com is blocked by the network egress proxy.

THE_ASYMMETRY_THAT_MATTERS.concrete_next_step: FU-1's remaining half is: find or build a GitHub-hosted MLB results archive carrying finals keyed by MLB gamePk. The already-admitted lancebroz/mlb-pitcher-data carries gamePks for every game and NO runs column (RJ-001B, standing). A sibling archive with scores would close it.
THE_ASYMMETRY_THAT_MATTERS.explicitly_refused: reconstructing runs from the pitch-level events column by running a baseball state machine. That would be an INFERRED final wearing the costume of an observed one, and its errors would be silent.
THE_ASYMMETRY_THAT_MATTERS.implication: the admissible-source frontier for this deployment is 'what is mirrored into a public GitHub repository', not 'what a sports API publishes'. WNBA works precisely because wehoop mirrors ESPN into git.
THE_ASYMMETRY_THAT_MATTERS.observation: github.com IS reachable (the git proxy serves it) while every sports content domain and now the league's own API are not.

why: the owner asked directly: 'If your environment can reach MLB's Stats API, that becomes your canonical lane for baseball specifically.' Probed with the APPROVED fetch tool. This is the fact the whole MLB lane turns on, so it is recorded rather than assumed.
